name: Thesis
description: A thesis or dissertation: a title page, the abstract and acknowledgements, the table of contents with the lists of figures and tables, the chapters, then appendices and bibliography.

source.name: The usual order of a thesis, common to the universities' guides
source.notes: Universities differ in the details of the title page and in whether the abstract precedes the acknowledgements; the layout and the citation style are the writer's own or the department's.
